title: Oxiana Limited - proposed merger with Zinifex Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Oxiana Limited's proposed acquisition of Zinifex Limited
body_sections.Market definition: Relevant markets for the purpose of this competition assessment were the Australian markets for the production and supply of: - zinc concentrate; - copper concentrate; - lead concentrate; and - gold and silver dore.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 30 April 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets.  Factors informing this view included: - the global nature of the pricing mechanisms coupled with fragmented concentration in the relevant markets; and - the robust alternative domestic supply by companies such as Kagara, Xstrata and BHP Billiton.
